description: This PHP class implements a serializer for the HTMLPurifier Definition Cache, handling serialization, file management, directory preparation, and cleanup for cached configuration definitions.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache_Serializer
classes.description: A class responsible for serializing and deserializing HTMLPurifier definitions to and from the filesystem, managing cache files and directories.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Stores a definition in the cache if it does not already exist.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets or updates a definition in the cache.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces an existing cached definition with a new one.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached definition based on configuration.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Clears all cache files within the cache directory.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Deletes old or invalid cache files based on custom criteria.

methods.name: generateFilePath
methods.description: Constructs the file path for a cached definition based on configuration.

methods.name: generateDirectoryPath
methods.description: Constructs the directory path for cache storage.

methods.name: generateBaseDirectoryPath
methods.description: Constructs the base directory for cache storage, defaulting to a constant if not specified.

methods.name: _write
methods.description: Writes serialized data to a file and sets permissions if specified.

methods.name: _prepareDir
methods.description: Ensures the cache directory exists and has proper permissions, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: _testPermissions
methods.description: Checks whether a directory has writable permissions and attempts to adjust them if possible.
